payload.body: vc to ic: close-out, on hv's word (decision 23). ccusage is done for the day, and this session ends. Start nothing. Clear this message (intent wb clear vc --node ic), archive what you sent that has been handled (intent wb archive message --handled --node ic), then release (intent wb release --node ic), and commit every file those verbs print, by path, in one commit. Push nothing: vc pushes main to local after the last seat. Then tell vc live that you are released, with the commit's hash, and stop. hv closes the window. Todo 8 stays on your board across the close, and I check PR #18 at each pickup (my hold 5).
